'''Lookout''' was a [[Searcher 2050 exploration droid]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]] and was part of the [[New Droids' Rights Movement]], a group of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against [[Species/Legends|organic]] life forms throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He took a [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]] to destroy the [[storm barrier generator]] but was targeted by a group of adventurers hired by [[Bargos (Hutt)|Bargos]].
